description: This source file defines data classes used for chat message handling, including message content, session entries, history, and attachments, within an Android application.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a chat message with an ID, role, list of content parts, and an optional timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Encapsulates the content of a chat message, supporting different content types such as text or files.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Models a pending tool call within a chat, including its ID, name, arguments, timestamp, and error status.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the chat session, with a key, last updated timestamp, and optional display name.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Contains the history of a chat session, including session key, ID, thinking level, and list of messages.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Defines an outgoing file attachment with type, MIME type, filename, and base64-encoded data.
